attributes.action: Social services to wear camcorders at all times no exceptions.
attributes.additional_details: For far to long there have been accusations from all sides stating wrong doings. This will eliminate all doubt once and fir all. Police wear them,security guards, traffic wardens and so on. This way there is no room for lies at all. It will be so transparent for everyone, for to long the families have been ignored bullied and harassed by social workers. These levels the playing field for everyone and is definitely a must fir future transparency.
attributes.background: At all times social services/workers to wear video recording equipment for any home visit or interaction with families. This creates transparency for everyone at all times. Reducing the opportunity for any lies or underhand events taking place by all parties.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: 

Require social workers to use body-worn cameras during statutory visits: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/757141
